title: $ETH looks very close to a local bottom, if not already in one.
subTitle:
Looking at historical price action $ETH has repeatedly formed major local bottoms when momentum indicators, especially RSI, dipped into deeply oversold territory and then stabilized. On the chart these zones are highlighted clearly, where selling pressure gradually weakens and price starts building a base.
{future}(ETHUSDT)

Currently $ETH is once again revisiting a similar region. The RSI has reached levels that historically coincided with previous accumulation phases suggesting that downside momentum is fading. While this does not guarantee an immediate reversal, it strongly increases the probability that ETH is in a bottoming process rather than the start of a new impulsive downtrend.
From a market structure perspective ETH has already corrected significantly from its recent highs, shaking out late longs and forcing weak hands to exit. This type of price behavior is often seen near local bottoms, where fear dominates sentiment but smart money starts accumulating quietly.
In the short term, volatility may remain, and further downside wicks are still possible. However, as long as ETH holds this zone, the risk-reward for new shorts becomes less attractive, while patient spot accumulation and carefully managed long positions start to make more sense.

title: Los HECHICEROS
subTitle:
En estos días de frenéticos movimientos, no hay ni un super experto, mago, hechicero, guru, etc. 
Nadie puede utilizando -o mejor dícho nadie pudó- las miles herramientas que existen, así como los miles de indicadóres, pronósticar, los cambíos de precíos-a la baja- generalizádos ocurrídos en el amplío mercado de las criptomonedas.
Una ves realizado todos los movimientos y surja la recuperación del mercado o su precipitada bajada de las principales monedas tales como $BTC  y $ETH , saldran muchos con sus graficos a indicar que ya ellos sabian hasta donde sería la caida de tal o cual criptomneda, así como el momemto preciso del cambío de difección. 
Todos esos expertós se encuentrán absortos en un inmensó silencío, solo comentarios especúlando sobre posíbles niveles de soportes y resistencias. Pero un comentarío precíso fijando un nível o cifra hasta donde puede caer un precio y su posterior recuperación y fijación de cambío de dirección nadie lo puéde pre decir. 
Por ende queda demostrado que así uses miles de dátos y herramientas acompañadas de indicadores, solo existe un solo método seguro y provado, que consisté en seguír la tendencia del mercado, de las grandes mayorias, ya que ni las grandes ballenas que deben contar con inmensas inversiones en super equipos tanto de personas y equipos informáticos han experimentado grandes y millonarias pérdidas. 
Todos seguimos la tendencia del mercado, desde los inversores mínimos, así como los grandes despachos que asesoran a miles de personas que le confian miles de millones de dólares. No tienen un panorama claro de hasta donde es el piso y techo futuro del mercado.

- 300U for trend trading, wait for major movements, only consider exiting if the target exceeds 15%;

If you haven’t seen the direction clearly, step aside first, observe the signals, and wait until a breakout is confirmed before acting. You have no system, I do.

Even if you get it wrong several times in a row,

the account won’t be seriously hurt.

like a sniper, waiting for that high-probability shot.

adjust the position strategy simultaneously.

It’s not about getting rich quickly,

the more it rolls, the steadier and bigger it gets.

that’s just luck winning once in a while.

What you are losing now,

is not necessarily a market issue,

To turn around,

#zec 爆仓一次清零，亏掉30万U，后来用5000U打了回来

那次失误之后，我账户直接归零。

30万U没了，不是行情狠，是我自己乱。

#ETH 很长一段时间我都在想：

这条路，是不是走到头了？

后来我用仅剩的 5000U 重新开始。

47 天后，账户回到 30 万U。

#BEATUSDT 不是撞大运，也不是突然开窍，

而是我终于把仓位和规则这两件事刻进骨子里。

很多人问我：

为什么你能翻，我却天天亏？

为什么你能躲过大回撤，我却总被扫？

答案只有一个：

你没体系，我有。

这套打法不玄，甚至有点“笨”，

但它能活、能复制、能放大。

第一步：本金必须拆，不许孤注一掷

5000U，我直接分成 5 份。

每一份都是子弹，不是炸弹。

除非信号极其明确，否则绝不一次打完。

先保证还在场上，再谈机会。

第二步：每一单都先想最坏结果

不赌方向，只算概率。

每笔都设好止损，

最大回撤严格控制在一个可承受范围内。

哪怕连续错几次，

账户也不会伤筋动骨。

第三步：只做“强逻辑 + 技术共振”

我不追热闹，也不天天操作。

关键位置才出手，

就像狙击手，只等高胜率那一枪。

没有信号，我宁愿空仓。

第四步：利润滚动，仓位跟着升级

当本金慢慢抬升，

仓位策略同步调整。

不是一把暴富，

而是像雪球一样，

越滚越稳、越滚越大。

很多人迷信梭哈，

那是偶尔赢一次的运气。

我做的是一套能长期放大的胜率系统。

你现在亏的，

真不一定是行情问题，

而是没人教你如何管理仓位、控制节奏。

想翻身，

你需要的从来不是下一次暴涨，

而是一套能让你不再乱输的方法。

路我已经走过了，

灯也亮着。

剩下的，就看你愿不愿意按规则走回来。

title: Pi Network Sees 1.2 Million Tokens Leave Exchanges in 24 Hours
subTitle:
Pi Network experienced notable exchange outflows this week, with more than 1.2 million PI tokens withdrawn from centralized platforms over the past day. The token is currently trading near $0.20, rebounding from a midweek low of $0.19, although it remains down on both weekly and monthly timeframes.
Exchange Outflows Signal Reduced Selling Pressure
On-chain data indicates that roughly 428 million PI tokens are still held on centralized exchanges. Gate.io controls the largest share, accounting for over half of that total, while Bitget ranks second with approximately 147.6 million tokens.

Opinions on Pi Network’s outlook remain sharply split.
Some traders remain optimistic. X user Web3_Vibes suggested that the token could see further upside after rebounding from support near $0.192. Other community members have floated price targets as high as $100, though such projections are widely viewed as unrealistic given current market conditions.
At the same time, frustration is growing within the community. X user pinetworkmembers criticized the project’s slow progress, describing Pi Network as evolving from an “ambitious idea” into “years of tapping a button, unclear timelines, shifting goals, and endless ‘coming soon’ updates,” while pointing to a lack of transparency around the project’s long-term direction.

title: XRP Ledger Amendment Blocks Nearly Half Of All Servers Over Upgrade Delays
subTitle:
XRP Ledger Amendment Blocks Nearly Half Of All Servers Over Upgrade Delays
XRP network operators face a significant infrastructure challenge as outdated servers prepare for automatic disconnection. Nearly 418 out of 999 XRP Ledger servers will become amendment-blocked, forcing operators to upgrade or lose network participation.
What Happened: Mandatory Upgrade
Krippenreiter, a community tracker on X, warned that the amendment-blocking process will prevent outdated rippled servers from determining ledger validity, submitting transactions, processing payments or participating in consensus.
The mechanism represents a built-in safety feature rather than a network failure, automatically sidelining servers running obsolete software when new protocol rules activate.
All designated Unique Node List validators remain operational and will continue validating transactions as expected.
XRPL.org's release notes for rippled 2.6.2 detail a new fixDirectoryLimit amendment alongside critical bug fixes that production infrastructure operators should implement immediately.
Also Read: Pi Network Records 1.2 Million Token Exodus From Exchanges In Single Day
Why It Matters: Consensus Continuity
The amendment-blocking process follows XRP Ledger's standard governance protocol, requiring sustained supermajority support from trusted validators over two weeks before activation.
Krippenreiter emphasized that consensus derives from the trusted validator set, with fee escalation mechanisms designed to increase transaction costs during high-traffic periods to prevent spam and overload attempts.
Other XRPL observers characterized the situation as routine maintenance occurring during nearly every amendment cycle.
However, hundreds of public servers falling behind simultaneously creates practical complications for wallets, explorers and businesses relying on third-party infrastructure, potentially reducing redundancy and creating temporary service disruptions.
The XRP Ledger amendment activation remains ongoing, and this article will be updated as the situation develops.

translatedData.content:
Want to understand the contract clearly? Following the market sentiment is basically a dead end. You chase after a surge, and you also chase after a pullback. It seems like you're working hard, but in reality, you're continuously giving money to the market. In this state, it's really better to leave early.
What I do now is actually very simple. First, I look at the overall trend. I will only start to seriously monitor the market when I judge that there is a chance for the market to make a larger move, for example, more than 30% volatility. As soon as I get close to a potential turning point, I will enter with a small position and hold, rather than waiting for the market to move before jumping in.
If the market moves as expected, then I hold patiently and look for suitable positions to add a little more. I must say, adding to a position is much harder than entering, as I prefer not to act in uncertain areas regarding how much and when to add, because if I add incorrectly, it can easily disrupt my mindset. If the market does not move as anticipated, then I accept it—stop loss, hedge, or simply exit and wait for the next opportunity.
This way of trading has a very realistic problem, which is that often a single trade floats five or ten points, only to return to the breakeven price. Sometimes, it feels like riding a roller coaster for a month, which is very torturous. But as long as I’m right about the preceding large move, those earlier fluctuations basically don’t matter.
If you want to grow small funds, I’ve always believed it should be done this way. Use the money you can afford to lose, and patiently wait for opportunities with a sufficiently large risk-reward ratio, at least 1 to 10. Now there are so many high-leverage platforms available; if you’re wrong, you get liquidated and stop loss, and wait for the next time; if you’re right, you ride with the trend and go along with it. As long as you catch a wave, multiplying your account by ten or twenty times is not a fantasy.
Frequent short-term trading, going in and out for a few points, will only narrow your perspective, and in the end, you won’t even be able to hold onto a complete market movement. This method is not effective in practice because you have to constantly contend with your own human nature. Those who can succeed in this market are likely to do well; those who cannot should stop early, at least to preserve some gains.
If you really want to continue on this path but don’t know how to start, you can watch more, learn more, and slowly find your rhythm back. Don’t rush; the market is always there.

想把合约玩明白，跟着市场情绪跑基本就是死路一条。暴涨你追，回调你也追，看着好像很努力，其实一直在给市场送钱，这种状态，真的不如早点离开。
我现在做单，其实很简单。先看大势，只有当我判断行情有机会走出一波比较大的空间，比如三成以上的波动，我才会开始认真盯盘。只要接近可能出现转折的位置，就先轻仓进去埋着，而不是等市场走出来再冲。
行情要是按预期走，那就耐心拿着，找合适的位置再加一点仓。这里必须说一句，加仓比进场难多了，加多少、什么时候加，没把握的地方我宁愿不动，因为一旦加错，很容易把心态搞崩。行情要是没走出来，那就认，止损、对冲，或者直接出局，等下一次。
这种玩法有个很现实的问题，就是经常一单浮盈五个点、十个点，最后又拿回成本价，有时候一个月看着像是在坐过山车，很折磨。但只要对上一波大的，前面那些折腾基本都不算事。
小资金想做大，我一直觉得就该这么来。用你能承受亏损的钱，耐心等盈亏比足够大的机会，至少一比十那种。现在高杠杆的平台这么多，错了就爆仓止损，等下一次；对了就顺着趋势拿、顺着走，只要抓住一波，账户翻十几倍、二十倍都不是幻想。
频繁撸短线，看几个点进进出出，只会把眼界越做越小，最后连一段完整行情都拿不住。这个方法不好用在手上，因为你得一直跟自己的人性较劲。能做到的，在这个市场大概率能活得不错；做不到的，早点收手，至少还能保住点成果。
如果你真想在这条路上走下去，又不知道怎么下手，可以多看看、多学学，慢慢把节奏找回来，别急，行情一直都在。

The Bank of Japan has raised interest rates to 0.75%, the highest level seen in the last 30 years, and this move has caught global markets by surprise. Japan has long been a major source of cheap liquidity, where investors borrowed yen at low rates and deployed that capital into risk assets like $BTC ,#ETH , and equities 💴🔄. With rates now moving higher, this carry trade may slow down, which can create short term pressure and volatility in the crypto market 📉😬. As a result, BTC and $ETH  could see temporary pullbacks or choppy price action in the near term.

However, it’s important to keep the bigger picture in mind. Even at 0.75%, Japan’s interest rates are still extremely low compared to the U.S. and Europe 🌍💵. This means global liquidity is not suddenly disappearing, and there is no strong reason to expect an immediate panic dump in crypto ❌. Bitcoin is increasingly viewed as digital gold 🟡, while Ethereum continues to be supported by strong fundamentals, network growth, and its expanding ecosystem ⚙️🔥.

Overall, this development points more toward short term weakness or sideways consolidation rather than a full trend reversal 🧩📊. The long term structure for crypto remains bullish 💪🚀, and smart money often uses macro driven dips as accumulation opportunities 🧠💰. Instead of reacting emotionally, traders should focus on planning, risk management, and patience to navigate this phase effectively 😌📈.

title: Vì Sao Giá BTC Đi Trong Biên Hẹp ? Nó Thể Hiện Điều Gì ? Hãy Thật Cẩn Thận !
subTitle:
BTC đi ngang trong biên 84.000 – 90.000 USD, mở rộng hơn là 80.000 – 95.000 USD, nhìn thì chán, nhưng thực ra đây là một trong những giai đoạn đáng chú ý của cả chu kỳ. Không phải vì giá không muốn chạy, mà vì thị trường đang chơi một ván cờ của dòng tiền, tâm lý và sự kiên nhẫn.
Ở vùng giá này, Bitcoin không còn rẻ để FOMO, nhưng cũng chưa đủ xấu để khiến người ta hoảng loạn. Người mua mới đứng ngoài vì sợ đu đỉnh. Người mua sớm thì chốt lời dần, không còn động lực giữ trọn vị thế. Còn những tay chơi lớn, họ không vội. Họ không cần đẩy giá lên cao hơn, cũng chẳng muốn đạp xuống sâu. Việc giữ BTC đi ngang trong một cái hộp giá chật hẹp chính là cách tối ưu lợi nhuận mà không cần tạo xu hướng.
Biên 84k – 90k thực chất là vùng kill các vị thế ngắn hạn sử dụng đòn bẩy cao. Mỗi nhịp BTC đạp xuống 84k–85k là một lần quét Long hưng phấn. Mỗi nhịp bật lên sát 90k lại là một lần bóp Short tự tin. Thị trường phái sinh có thanh khoản cao, đòn bẩy lớn, và trong bối cảnh đó, việc để giá đi ngang mang lại lợi nhuận ổn định hơn nhiều so với việc đẩy trend. Cá mập không cần thắng bằng hướng đi của giá, họ thắng bằng thời gian và sự mệt mỏi của số đông.
Nhìn rộng ra vùng 80.000 – 95.000 USD, đây giống một pha tái phân phối hơn là phân phối đỉnh. Bitcoin không sập, nhưng cũng không bay. Một phần holder cũ xả dần khi đã có lợi nhuận lớn. Một phần dòng tiền mới âm thầm gom, nhưng rất thận trọng. Dòng tiền ETF spot vẫn vào, chỉ là không còn bùng nổ như giai đoạn đầu. BTC đang đổi chủ từng chút một, trong im lặng, không tiếng trống kèn.
Ở phía sau, bối cảnh vĩ mô đóng vai trò như gió ngược nhẹ. Lãi suất chưa được cắt mạnh. Đồng USD vẫn giữ sức và dòng tiền chưa quay lại toàn diện. Không có tin xấu đủ lớn để khiến thị trường sụp đổ mạnh hơn nữa, nhưng cũng chưa có catalyst đủ mạnh để tạo một cú bứt phá rõ ràng. Trong môi trường như vậy, đi ngang là trạng thái cân bằng hợp lý nhất.
Điều quan trọng hơn cả là yếu tố tâm lý. Range càng kéo dài, nhà đầu tư càng dễ mất kiên nhẫn. Người cầm spot bắt đầu nghi ngờ quyết định của mình. Người trade liên tục bị quét hai đầu. Chính trong những giai đoạn như thế này, tiền thực sự được chuyển từ tay người thiếu kỷ luật sang tay người kiên nhẫn hơn. Bitcoin hiếm khi lấy tiền của người thông minh một cách vội vàng; nó lấy tiền của những người không chịu nổi sự chờ đợi.
Vì vậy, BTC đi ngang không phải vì nó yếu, mà vì thị trường đang chuẩn bị cho một cú đánh đủ lớn để định hướng phần còn lại của chu kỳ. Phá lên hay phá xuống ? Ai còn trụ lại được sau giai đoạn tra tấn này, người đó sẽ có cơ hội

title: Ethereum sinks as major groups sell $51mln – Yet ONE signal hints at relief
subTitle:
Ethereum sinks as major groups sell $51mln – Yet ONE signal hints at relief
Ethereum remained under heavy pressure as broader market weakness dragged altcoins lower.
After peaking near $4,900 earlier this cycle, Ethereum stayed locked in a downtrend with only brief recovery attempts. At press time, ETH traded near $2,856, down 2.36% daily and about 10% weekly.
That sustained decline appeared to push both whales and institutions toward the exit.
Whales head for the door
#On-chain  data showed a major Ethereum [ETH] whale accelerating profit-taking.
According to Onchain Lens, the whale deposited 7,654 ETH, worth about $21.62 million, into Binance. Lookonchain reported that this transaction locked in roughly $4 million in profit.
A few hours earlier, the same address deposited 10,169 ETH, valued near $29.77 million, realizing an additional $11.36 million gain.

In total, the whale offloaded 17,823 ETH, worth approximately $51.4 million, through Binance deposits.
Blockchain records showed the whale originally withdrew 19,505.5 ETH, staked the assets, and later redeposited 20,269 ETH. That strategy generated about 763.58 #ETH  in staking rewards.
After the latest deposits, cumulative realized profit stood near $15.36 million.
Historically, whale selling during prolonged downtrends often reflected fading confidence. Large holders typically exited when they expected further downside risk.
Institutions are even more bearish
In addition to individual whales exiting the market, institutional investors have dominated the sell-side activity. 
Data from SoSoValue showed Ethereum Spot #ETFs  recorded net outflows for five consecutive sessions. Over that period, cumulative outflows reached about $533.25 million.

On the 17th of December, for example, outflows jumped to -$22.43 million, reflecting intense selling pressure. As a result, Ethereum’s Spot ETFs saw Total Assets drop from $21 billion to $17 billion, marking a $4 billion dip in five days.
Such a sustained period of outflows suggests that institutions turned bearish and reduced exposure, an apparent lack of market conviction.
A breakdown or a rebound?
Ethereum’s price action reflected that caution.
Sellers continued defending higher levels, while buyers struggled to sustain rebounds. That imbalance kept ETH locked in a broader downtrend.
Momentum indicators reinforced the bearish tone. The Stochastic Momentum Index dropped into oversold territory, reflecting heavy downside pressure.

At press time, ETH hovered just above the 0.618 Fibonacci Retracement near $2,807. A failure to hold that level could open the door to a move toward the 0.786 retracement around $2,633.
However, exchange activity hinted at a potential short-term shift.

Exchange Netflows turned sharply negative, falling to about -47,100 ETH from roughly +46,000 ETH the prior day. That swing suggested reduced sell-side pressure and emerging demand.
If buyers defended the $2,807 zone, ETH could attempt a rebound toward $2,929. A stronger recovery would place resistance near the $3,200 region.

title: Bitcoin & Ethereum Diverge as Traders Take Opposite Bets
subTitle:
#ETH #BTC #ADA #Ada The crypto market is showing a clear split in sentiment between Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH), according to recent on-chain data. While traders are increasingly betting on Bitcoin’s upside, Ethereum is seeing a rise in short positions, signaling short-term caution.
Data from Santiment highlights a divergence in funding rates, a key derivatives indicator. Bitcoin’s funding rate has remained positive, meaning long traders are dominant and are paying shorts. This suggests continued bullish confidence in BTC, even after recent volatility that saw prices briefly spike above $90,000 before dropping back toward the mid-$80,000 range.
Ethereum, on the other hand, has flipped to a negative funding rate following a sharp rally and quick sell-off. After climbing close to $3,000, ETH dropped below $2,800, weakening bullish sentiment and pushing more traders to open short positions.
Interestingly, this bearish tilt on Ethereum may not be entirely negative. Historically, extreme long positioning has often led to large liquidations and increased volatility. With fewer leveraged longs in the market, ETH could see more stable price action in the near term.
Analysts note that despite this divergence, Bitcoin still leads the broader market. For BTC to make a sustained push toward $100,000 and for altcoins to rebound strongly, Bitcoin’s funding rates may need to cool down or turn neutral.
For now, the market reflects a cautious optimism toward Bitcoin and a more defensive stance on Ethereum, highlighting how trader sentiment can sharply differ even among top cryptocurrencies.

Crypto Markets Today: Bitcoin rallies on Japan rate hike as futures traders pile in

BTC rose to $88,000 after the Bank of Japan raised interest rates. The increase, seen as a potential risk-off trigger, failed to spark a flight into the yen.

What to know:

BTC rose to $88,000 from $85,200 in five hours after the BOJ hiked rates

The increase had been seen as a potential risk-off trigger, but failed to spark a flight into the yen.

Open interest rose faster than price, and funding rates flipped decisively positive, signaling fresh leveraged longs rather than short covering.

SOL and XRP saw declining open interest and altcoin-season indicators hit new lows, while ETH outperformed BTC despite broader weakness.

The crypto market's rich vein of volatility extended into Friday morning, with bitcoin BTC$- rising from a 1:00 a.m. UTC low of $85,200 to $88,000 over five hours after the Bank of Japan increased interest rates to the highest level in 30 years.

The move marked the fourth time bitcoin has jumped by more than 2% this week, although each rally has been temporary and quickly faded as price action resembles the choppy behavior of previous crypto bear markets.
Nasdaq 100 futures rose by 0.62% during the same five-hour window as the yen fell, suggesting that the rate hike was priced in and investors weren't rushing to swap risk assets for Japan's national currency.

A Bank of Japan rate hike is often thought to be bearish for risk assets because it could make the yen more expensive to borrow and spur the unwinding of the carry trade, in which traders borrow cheap yen at low rates and use it to buy higher-yielding assets like U.S. bonds, equities and crypto.

$ETH  Price Forecast: Ethereum Foundation Proposes Solutions to Address the Pressure of an Increasingly Expanding "State" Size

The Ethereum Foundation (EF) Stateless Consensus research group recently warned that Ethereum's "states" are rapidly expanding following recent scaling upgrades, creating long-term risks to the network's decentralization and censorship resistance.

State encompasses all the core data that powers Ethereum, from account information and smart contract storage to bytecode. It's the foundational layer that wallets, dApps, block explorers, and RPC infrastructure providers constantly query to maintain operation. As state grows uncontrollably, node operating costs will escalate, making full node operation increasingly inaccessible to individuals and small operators.

According to EF, the core problem lies in the fact that Ethereum's state only grows in one direction. Every new account or every on-chain data write creates information that must be stored permanently. Notably, about 80% of the state is currently inaccessible for more than a year, yet nodes are still forced to store the entire block of data. This increases the risk of centralizing the infrastructure in the hands of a few large organizations.

To address this problem, the Stateless Consensus team proposes three parallel approaches: state expiry, state archive, and partial statelessness. These solutions aim to separate “hot” and “cold” state, temporarily removing infrequently used data from the active state, and allowing nodes to store only the necessary portion of the state. The ultimate goal is to reduce operating costs, lower the barrier to entry for node operation, and protect decentralization – the core foundation of Ethereum in the long term.

content:
⚠️ Vitalik Raises a Serious Concern About Ethereum’s Future

Vitalik Buterin recently highlighted an issue that goes far beyond price, upgrades, or new L2s. His concern is about trustlessness, the very principle Ethereum was built on. As Ethereum’s technology stack becomes more advanced, it’s also becoming so complex that only a small group of expert developers can fully understand the protocol end to end. That creates a paradox. We removed trust from banks, but are we slowly replacing it with trust in a technical elite?

Vitalik argues that true trustlessness isn’t just about removing intermediaries, but about increasing the number of people who can actually verify and understand how the system works. If only a handful of people can do that, Ethereum risks drifting away from its core idea.

The solution, according to him, isn’t adding more features, but simplifying the system. Ideas like stateless clients could lower the barrier to running a node, while simpler L2 designs that rely more on Ethereum’s base-layer security could reduce unnecessary complexity. Technologies such as Verkle Trees and PeerDAS are early steps in this direction.

For long-term believers, this is an important discussion. A simpler and more verifiable Ethereum strengthens decentralization and security, which ultimately benefits investors, developers, and users alike. The real question is whether the ecosystem is willing to choose simplification over constant complexity, or whether technological progress inevitably makes systems harder to understand.

Curious to hear different perspectives on this. 👇

Bitcoin to take a year off?! Fidelity issues a major warning: is 65000 a solid bottom or the starting point of a bubble? Don't wait for a crash to understand what a market correction means!

Fidelity just dropped a bombshell, stating that Bitcoin is set to enter a year of suspension, with a potential winter lasting a year, and support levels seen at 65,000 to 75,000. Many panicked at first glance, wondering if it's the end of the line?

Let me tell you, don't panic! This is the real moment to understand the cognitive gap. While others see a winter, I see a period of adjustment.

Bitcoin has been running for 145 months, soaring to 125,000 dollars; shouldn’t it catch its breath? This is not a crash; the market is simply taking a deep breath. Fidelity's statement might seem like a warning on the surface, but it's actually telling you: don’t expect daily surges; the market is entering a 'mental adjustment phase'.

Gold has risen 65% this year; what about Bitcoin?
Jurien Timmer has compared gold, and it's quite harsh; this clearly reminds us: funds are not out of places to go, but are temporarily switching venues. If the gold bull market can maintain its gains, Bitcoin needs to learn to withstand volatility. What does this indicate? It shows that global funds are still searching for safe havens; Bitcoin is merely in a temporary accumulation mode, not a signal to exit!

What does a support level of 65,000 to 75,000 mean?
It tells you: don’t fall below 65,000; dropping below that is an opportunity to get hit; maintaining above 75,000 indicates strong consolidation. This middle segment is meant to wash away those who can’t hold on or don’t understand. While you're panicking, institutions are watching the range.

So what should players do?
Don’t be frightened by the term 'year of suspension'. This isn’t telling you to go cash out; it’s telling you: be ready to buy when it drops, and don’t go crazy when it rises. Position management is more important than anything else; keep some bullets, operate within the range, and don’t foolishly hold all in or clear out waiting for zero. The market never lacks opportunities, only patience.

In a bull market, everyone can make money; a bear market reveals who is swimming naked. 2026 is not the end of Bitcoin, but the start of your investment mindset. The shakeout is not about the market; it’s about the luck in your mind.

What players need to do is patiently wait for opportunities, act decisively and steadily. Pay attention to the resources, come to the village to get daily shared real-time strategies + cutting loss guidelines! #BTC #eth

quoteContent.body: Bloomberg прогнозирует обвал биткоина до $10 000 уже в 2026 году
quoteContent.title: Bloomberg прогнозирует обвал биткоина до $10 000 уже в 2026 году
quoteContent.bodyTextOnly:
Рынок криптовалют, переживающий не лучшие времена после достижения октябрьских максимумов, столкнулся с новым пугающим прогнозом. Forbes пишет о предупреждении аналитиков, которые прогнозируют схлопывание индустрии объемом $3 трлн и падении курса биткоина до уровней 2020 года.

С момента достижения пика в $126 000 курс биткоина уже упал более чем на 30%. Однако, по мнению экспертов, это может быть только началом масштабного обвала.
Майк Макглоун, старший стратег по сырьевым товарам Bloomberg Intelligence, считает, что биткоин может вернуться к отметке $10 000 в 2026 году. Такое падение почти на 90% от текущих уровней сократит капитализацию всего крипторынка с $3 трлн до $300 млрд.
Причиной такого сценария Макглоун называет «постинфляционную дефляцию» и неизбежный крах высокоспекулятивных цифровых активов, большинство из которых «ничего не отслеживают» и не имеют реальной ценности.
Стратег проводит тревожную аналогию с фондовым рынком 2007 года. Тогда акции США достигли рекордных максимумов, а ФРС начала снижать ставки для борьбы с экономическим стрессом. Несмотря на снижение ставок, рынок вскоре рухнул более чем на 50%, что привело к мировому финансовому кризису 2008 года.
«Падение биткоина может зеркально отразить ситуацию с акциями 2007 года на фоне действий ФРС», — предупреждает Макглоун, отмечая, что с момента сентябрьского снижения ставки ФРС биткоин уже потерял почти 25%.
Другие аналитики также видят признаки слабости. Дэвид Моррисон из Trade Nation отмечает, что рынок «выдыхается». По его словам, существует реальная опасность пробоя недавних минимумов, и повторное падение к уровню $80 000 в ближайшее время нельзя исключать.

Uzman beklentileri ve güncel makroekonomik veriler, kripto paralar için 2026’nın ilk çeyreğini güçlü bir boğa piyasası adayı hâline getiriyor. Analistlere göre Bitcoin’in bu dönemde 300.000–600.000 dolar bandını test etmesi ihtimal dâhilinde. Bu iyimserliğin temelinde, küresel likidite koşullarındaki iyileşme ve para politikasındaki gevşeme sinyalleri yer alıyor.
İlk olarak, ABD Merkez Bankası’nın (Fed) bilanço küçültmeyi durdurması, geçmiş döngülerde Bitcoin’de %40’a varan yükselişlerle ilişkilendirildi (Cowen, 2024). İkinci olarak, faiz indirimlerinin 2026’da da sürmesi, düşük getiri ortamında yatırımcıları kripto gibi riskli varlıklara yöneltebilir (Federal Reserve, 2025). Üçüncü faktör, kısa vadeli likiditenin artmasıdır. Hazine bonosu alımları ve bilanço politikaları, risk iştahını destekleyici bir zemin oluşturabilir (CoinMarketCap, 2025).
Dördüncü olarak, ABD ara seçimleri (Kasım 2026) öncesinde piyasalarda sert dalgalanmalardan kaçınılması beklenmektedir. Bu durum, düzenleyici belirsizliği sınırlayabilir (Froehlich, 2025). Son olarak, zayıflayan istihdam verileri, Fed’i daha güvercin politikalara zorlayarak kripto piyasası için elverişli bir likidite ortamı yaratabilir (IMF, 2024).
Sonuç: Tüm bu faktörler eş zamanlı gerçekleşirse, 2026’nın ilk çeyreği kripto paralar için tarihsel ölçekte yeni bir boğa döngüsünün başlangıcı olabilir.

Ethereum (ETH) is a decentralized, open-source blockchain platform that functions like a global, programmable computer, allowing developers to build and run decentralized applications (dApps) and smart contracts without intermediaries like banks. Its native cryptocurrency, ether (ETH), fuels the network by paying for transaction fees (gas) and rewarding participants, making it the second-largest cryptocurrency after Bitcoin, but focused on functionality beyond just digital money.  

Key aspects of Ethereum:

Decentralized Platform: 

It's a network of computers (nodes) worldwide, making it transparent, secure, and censorship-resistant, unlike traditional systems controlled by single entities. 

Smart Contracts: 

These are self-executing contracts with terms directly written into code, automating agreements and enabling complex applications. 

Decentralized Applications (dApps): 

Ethereum enables apps for finance (DeFi), gaming, NFTs, and more, running on the blockchain. 

Ether (ETH): 

The fuel for the network; you use ETH to pay for the computational power (gas) needed to run smart contracts and process transactions, notes Invesco and Binance. 

"World Computer": 

Think of it as a shared, global computer where anyone can build and run applications, powered by blockchain's security and openness, explains Skrill. 

Evolution: 

It has evolved significantly, moving from a proof-of-work to a proof-of-stake system for better efficiency and scalability, and hosts many Layer 2 solutions for faster, cheaper transactions, according to Investopedia and this YouTube video. 

In essence, Ethereum provides the foundation for a decentralized internet, with Ether (ETH) as its essential currency and utility token, note Coinbase and this YouTube video.

subTitle:

The Bank of Japan just dropped a line the market is dangerously underestimating:
> “If economic and price conditions meet expectations, we will CONTINUE raising interest rates.”
Read that again.
⚠️ This was NOT a one-off hike. This is the START of a tightening cycle.
---
💣 Why this statement is DEADLIER than a simple “25bp hike”
Markets don’t price the past — they price what comes NEXT.
And the BOJ just made three things crystal clear:
1️⃣ This hike is not isolated
2️⃣ Future hikes are data-driven
3️⃣ If conditions align, they WILL keep tightening
Translation?
🇯🇵 Japan is shutting down its 30-year role as the world’s cheap-money ATM.
The trillion-dollar yen carry trade that fueled global risk assets is slowly being turned OFF.
---
📉 Why today’s BTC bounce means NOTHING
Don’t get fooled by green candles.
This pop is just a relief bounce because the “absolute worst case” didn’t happen yet.
The real threat is structural — and structural shifts don’t crash markets in one candle. They bleed them slowly.
📊 History doesn’t lie:
After Japan’s first rate hikes, BTC dropped -23%, -26%, -31%
Pattern every time:
Sideways → fake rebound → slow grind lower
That’s how tightening kills markets.
---
🧠 The most dangerous thing right now? MARKET PSYCHOLOGY
❌ Bad news → bounce
❌ Bounce → confidence returns
❌ Confidence → “This time is different”
Meanwhile, central banks are screaming the opposite.
---
🌍 Reality check:
• The Fed stays higher for longer
• Japan has just STARTED tightening
• Europe is still restrictive
• No new global liquidity is coming
This is NOT a risk-on environment.
---
🔎 3 indicators that will decide the next phase:
1️⃣ Does the yen keep strengthening?
2️⃣ Do U.S. bond yields rise passively?
3️⃣ Does arbitrage / carry trade volume shrink?
If these align — risk assets won’t survive
 on hopium.
⚠️ Stay sharp. Stay defensive.
This cycle is far from over.

#ETH Don't drag your friends onto the road; instead, meet like-minded people along the way.
A lazy fish lies comfortably, and if you insist on flipping it, no one will appreciate you, only blame you for meddling!
I am 35 years old this year and started getting into cryptocurrency trading at 24. During the bull market in 2021, my investment scale broke into eight figures.
My current life is very free; when I go out, I usually stay in high-end hotels costing around 2000 yuan, and I can casually buy watches worth over 100,000 without feeling pain! Even my suitcase and hat bear symbols from the crypto world. Compared to the older generation doing real business or the post-80s doing e-commerce, my life pressure is much smaller.

I have hardly experienced any business disputes and have fewer worries.
Looking back, the biggest realization along this journey is that the most important aspect of trading cryptocurrencies is mentality, followed by skills.

Here are some of my personal experience summaries:
Bitcoin is the barometer of the market
In most cases, Bitcoin dominates the ups and downs of the entire crypto market. A few high-quality coins like Ethereum may sometimes exhibit independent trends, but most altcoins cannot escape Bitcoin's influence.

The inverse relationship between Bitcoin and USDT
Usually, when USDT's price rises, Bitcoin tends to drop; conversely, when Bitcoin rises, it's relatively the right time to buy USDT.

The spike phenomenon between 0 and 1 o'clock
During this time period every day, the market occasionally experiences severe fluctuations. If you are a domestic user, you can place low buy and high sell orders before going to sleep, and you might be surprised by a successful transaction.

The key observation point is between 6 and 8 in the morning
If the price drops continuously from 0 to 6, and continues to drop from 6 to 8, there is a high probability of a rebound that day.

If the price rises continuously from 0 to 6, and continues to rise from 6 to 8, there is a high probability of a correction that day.

Fluctuations at 5 PM
Due to time zone differences, this is when American traders begin to become active, and the market often experiences fluctuations at this time, requiring special attention.

The 'Black Friday' phenomenon
There is a saying in the market about large drops on Fridays, but it is not absolute; there can also be significant rises or sideways movements. Just be cautious and pay attention to the news.

Many people are not unmotivated; rather, they are stumbling around in the dark alone, forever stuck in the same cycle. Remember, the market is always there, but the rhythm waits for no one.
What you need is not to run faster in chaos, but for someone to lift the lamp, allowing you to walk out of the darkness@Square-Creator-58b326784

content:
#ETH 不要硬拉着朋友上路，而在奔跑的路上结识志同道合的人。
咸鱼躺的好好的，你非去翻，没人感激你，只会怪你多管闲事！
我今年 35岁，从 24 岁开始接触炒币，2021年那波牛市资金规模突破到8位数。
现在的生活很自由，出门住的基本是 2000 元左右的高端酒店，10几万的手表，随便买几块都不心疼！行李箱、帽子上甚至还带着币圈符号。相比老一辈做实业，或者 80 后做电商，我的生活压力要小得多。

我几乎没经历过与人扯皮的生意，烦心事也少。
回头看，这一路最大的感悟是：炒币最重要的是心态，其次才是技术。

以下是我个人的一些经验总结：
比特币是行情的风向标
大多数情况下，比特币主导整个币圈涨跌。以太坊等少数品质强的币有时会走出独立行情，但大部分山寨币逃不脱比特币的影响。

比特币与 USDT 的反向关系
通常，USDT 价格上涨时，比特币容易下跌；而比特币上涨时，是买入 USDT 的相对合适时机。

0 点-1 点的插针现象
每天这个时间段，市场偶尔出现剧烈波动。如果你是国内用户，可以在睡前挂低买单和高卖单，说不定会意外成交。

早上 6-8 点是关键观察点
如果 0-6 点持续下跌，6-8 点仍在跌，当天大概率会反弹。

如果 0-6 点持续上涨，6-8 点仍在涨，当天大概率会调整。

下午 5 点的波动
因为时差关系，这是美国交易者开始活跃的时间段，市场常在此时出现波动，需要特别留意

“黑色星期五”现象
市场上有周五大跌的说法，但并不绝对，也可能大涨或横盘。谨慎关注消息面即可。

很多人不是不努力，而是一个人在黑夜里乱撞，永远在同一个循环里。记住，行情永远都在，但节奏不等人。
你需要的，不是更快地乱跑，而是有人能举起灯，让你走出黑夜@Square-Creator-58b326784
